summary: MODERN END TERRACE Located in the South Park end of town, deceptively spacious and ideal for a family. A stones throw away from South Park, the train station and the town centre. The property compromises - entrance hallway, large living room with bay window, dining room with patio doors, modern white fitted kitchen with washing machine and oven/hob. To the first floor are two double bedrooms and one large single, family bathroom with white suite and shower over the bath. Rear yard and garage.
